latest_interim.note: Q3-26 internal revenue growth 5.9% ($380m): total average yield 5.1% (C&D yield 3.4%, recycling & RE +8.6%, energy surcharge & mandated fees +42.2%), volume +0.8%, Healthcare Solutions ~0; acquisitions +0.6%, divestitures -0.1%, FX -0.1% -> total +6.3% ($6,846m). C&D core price 5.8%; C&D volume -0.4% (-0.5% workday-adjusted; intentional residential shedding and national-account broker losses). 9M-26: internal 4.1% (C&D yield 3.6%, volume +0.2%, HS -0.2%), total +4.6%; C&D volume -1.3% workday-adjusted. 2026 guidance affirmed: revenue at high end of $26.275-26.475bn, adj. operating EBITDA $8.15-8.25bn, FCF at high end of $3.75-3.85bn (TARGET). Note the qual's 'inconsistency' is not an error: total-company volume (+0.8%, incl. recycling/RNG) differs from C&D volume (-0.4%).

geography.note: 10-K 2025 states only: 'Our operations are primarily in the U.S. but we also have significant operations in Canada and certain countries in Western Europe' (Western Europe via Stericycle/Healthcare Solutions). No revenue-by-country table found in the 10-K text; percentages left null. FX translation impact on revenue only -0.1% in 2025, implying a small non-US share (INFERENCE). No China operations; support functions in India.

claim_checks.finding: Healthcare Solutions adjusted operating EBITDA margin 16.9% in FY2025 (+180bp), Q3-26 22.4% adjusted / 19.5% reported (Q3-25: 17.5% / 14.2%); Q3-26 revenue $651m +3.7%, adj. EBITDA $146m (+>30%). 2026 outlook: HS revenue ~+3% (price-driven), margin expansion from SG&A synergies. No quantified synergy target in the releases; Q3-26 Stericycle integration costs $30m.

C&D volume is flat-to-negative: FY25 +0.1% (+0.3% workday-adjusted, incl. ~50bp wildfire benefit), 9M-26 -1.3% workday-adjusted, Q3-26 -0.4% (-0.5% wda). 2026 guidance had assumed C&D volume +0.2-0.6% -> running below guide. Growth remains price-led (core price 6.3% FY25, 5.8% Q3-26; 2026 guide 5.4-5.8%).
WM release 26-Aug-2026: Jim Fish to retire and resign from Board; John Morris becomes President & CEO and joins Board effective 4-Jan-2027.
